main.description: Internal BPMN-driven capital-rail demand poll (ADR 2605011300 §7). Polls public BTC (mempool.space), ETH (eth.llamarpc.com JSON-RPC), and payment-rail status pages (Square, Coinbase, Plaid, Circle), maps signals to lanes by mempool/fee/gas/incident rules, and inserts vertex_market_demand_signal rows. Not externally callable.
